artworks.title: William, Count of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a historical figure standing from the knees up, facing slightly to the left. He holds a baton or staff in his right hand and rests his left hand on a sword at his side. The figure has a mustache and beard, with hair styled in loose waves. He wears ornate armor with engravings and a high collar. A helmet sits on a plinth beside him. The background is a decorative frame with heraldic symbols, inscriptions, and patterns. Smaller panels within the frame depict various scenes surrounded by floral designs and motifs.

artworks.title: William, Count of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a man standing in a three-quarter view. He is dressed in ornate armor with intricate designs, including a breastplate and pauldrons, and a ruffled collar typical of the period. His facial features include a short beard and a mustache, with curly hair surrounding a high forehead. The man holds a baton in one hand while the other rests on the hilt of a sword. Beside him on the ground is a plumed helmet. Surrounding the portrait is a decorative frame filled with floral motifs and symbolic imagery, including various mythical and allegorical figures. Above the main portrait is a small crest with words and illustrations. The background is filled with text and more illustrative panels.

artworks.title: William I, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person facing slightly to the left, with their head turned towards the viewer, capturing the upper half of their body. The person has a composed expression with a mustache and a distinct jawline. Their hair is styled short and is mostly covered by a cap matching their attire. The person is wearing intricately designed clothing with detailed embroidery, including ornate patterns and possibly armor-like elements on the shoulder. The background has linear patterns and the portrait is bordered by an oval frame. Decorative text surrounds the portrait.

artworks.title: William I, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The engraving depicts an upper-body portrait of a man with a mustache, well-defined jawline, a cap, high, pleated ruff collar, fur-lined coat, vertical striped patterns on garments, a decorative chain and a medallion. The image is set within an oval frame of elaborate scrollwork with inscriptions, against a textured, cross-hatched background.

artworks.title: William I, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a man in period attire within an oval frame. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right, sporting a moustache and a small patch of facial hair under his lower lip. His hair is covered by a cap and he wears an elaborate ruff collar and a coat with fur trim. The coat has decorative details such as buttons and stitching. The background has a hatched texture and the oval frame is inscribed with text. Below the oval, there is more text that likely identifies the subject and creator of the work.

artworks.title: William, Count of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26.9 x 18.2 cm (10 9/16 x 7 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a historical figure depicted in an oval frame. The person is visible from the waist up, standing with their head turned towards the viewer. They have a distinguished facial structure, with a beard and short hair. The figure is dressed in armor with ornate patterns, a high ruff, and a sash. They hold a baton in one hand, with a helmet nearby. The background has intricate designs and floral motifs, along with four separate scenes in smaller frames with Latin inscriptions. The overall presentation includes heraldic symbols and text.

artworks.title: William of Orange
artworks.artist: Cornelis van Dalen I after Gerrit van Honthorst
artworks.description: The image depicts a young boy with a rounded face, large expressive eyes, light-colored shoulder-length hair, and a wide-brimmed hat with a large feather. He is wearing a high-collared garment with lace trim and armor partially visible underneath. The background consists of an oval decorative frame with engravings and intricate patterns. Text below the portrait provides details about the person depicted, including titles and places of governance.

artworks.title: William II of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person standing from the thighs up. They have long, wavy hair and expressive facial features. They are dressed in an elaborate outfit with a ruffled lace collar and decorative armor. They are holding a baton in one hand, and an ornate helmet is on a pedestal nearby. The background has an architectural frame with decorative motifs.

artworks.title: William, Prince of Orange
artworks.artist: Cornelis Visscher after Gerrit van Honthorst
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the chest up, positioned facing slightly to the left while looking towards the viewer. He has distinct facial features, a neatly groomed mustache and beard, and is wearing a small cap on his head. His hair is short and lies beneath the cap. The man is dressed in a formal outfit with a fur-lined coat and a high-collared shirt with a prominent ruffled collar. There are no visible objects in his hands or any jewelry. The background is a detailed, textured pattern that frames the man within an oval border. The border includes an inscription along its top edge, and there is additional text below the oval.

artworks.title: William V, Duke of Julich and Cleves
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man. The man is shown in a three-quarter view, with no visible body below the chest. He has a prominent nose, a mustache and beard, and a serious expression. His hair is short and he wears a decorative beret with feathers and a circular brooch. He wears a high-collared garment with a large fur collar. The background features an inscribed circular frame with Latin inscriptions, likely naming the individual, and a plain patterned backdrop.

artworks.title: William Count la Marck, Duke of Julich and Cleves
artworks.description: The image depicts a man facing slightly to his left. He has a long, pointed nose, deep-set eyes, a short gray beard, and thinning gray hair peeking out from under his headwear. He wears a dark fur-lined robe with a high collar and a flat beret-like hat. In his left hand, he holds an object resembling a rolled-up piece of fabric or a scroll. The background features an intricately designed circular frame with text surrounding it, and a rectangular panel with text below the circle.

artworks.title: William, Duke of Saxony
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man with a bust portrait facing to the viewer's left. The man has a prominent nose, full beard, well-defined mustache, curly hair, and is dressed in a formal garment with intricate lace detailing on the shoulder area. The background includes an oval frame with hatching lines, an inscribed oval border with text "WILHELMUS DUX SAX" and the year "1623". Below the portrait, there is Latin text in four lines and the print is signed by the artist "Wolfgang Kilian fecit" at the bottom.

artworks.title: William V, Duke of Bavaria
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from the chest up, positioned facing slightly to his left with his head turned toward the viewer. He has facial features with a high forehead, eyebrows, a mustache, and a small goatee. His hair is short and appears to be thinning at the top. He is wearing an ornate garment with a high collar, trimmed in fur, and a decorative piece that loops over the collar. The background is plain with light shading, typical of an engraved portrait. Below the image, there is an inscription in Latin that appears to be identifying the person in the portrait along with the name of the engraver, Anton Wierix.

artworks.title: William of Nassau, Vice-Admiral of Holland
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man. He is facing slightly to his right with curly ear-length hair, a thin upward-curving mustache, and ornate clothing including a high ruffled collar and a striped doublet with decorative buttons. The man is surrounded by an intricately designed oval frame with swirling patterns and a shell motif at the top. The background is densely crosshatched, and text near the oval frame identifies the person as "Guillaume de Nassav Seigneur du Lec," accompanied by decorative scrollwork.

artworks.title: William Frederick of Nassau
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his left arm resting on a helmet and his right hand holding a staff. He has shoulder-length wavy hair and a serious expression. He wears intricate armor, a lace collar, a bracelet on his left wrist, and a sash across his chest. The background shows a pastoral landscape with soldiers on horseback in the sky.

artworks.title: William Louis, Count of Nassau
artworks.artist: Boëtius Adams Bolswert after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright, with a well-trimmed beard and mustache. He is dressed in elaborate armor, with a ruffled collar showing underneath. Beside him, there is a helmet with decorative plumes. He holds a baton in his right hand below his chest. The background features draped fabric.

artworks.title: Marc de Wilson, Chevalier Sieur de la Colombiere
artworks.description: The image is an ornate portrait engraving featuring a bust of a man in the center. The man has a mustache and curled hairstyle, wearing period attire with a lace collar, doublet, and draped sash. Surrounding the central portrait are two figures and symbolic objects. On the left stands a muscular, bearded, semi-nude man with a laurel wreath, holding a cudgel and resting his hand on the frame. On the right, a lion is posed with its paws on the frame. Above are a crest with a helmet, banners, and ribbons. At the bottom is a coat of arms surrounded by books, a globe, and various instruments. The background is detailed with shading and patterns.

artworks.title: Edward Cecil, Viscount Wimbledon
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man facing the viewer, dressed in ornate clothing with a baton in his right hand. Around him is a decorative oval frame with Latin text, a crest, and decorative scrollwork. Objects like spears and banners are visible in the background. The style suggests a historical or classical portrait engraving.

artworks.title: Wolfgang-Wilhelm, Count of Pfalz-Neuburg and Duke of Julich-Berg
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man's upper body. He is positioned in a three-quarter view, slightly turned to his left. The man has an older appearance with distinctive facial features, including a broad forehead, pronounced cheekbones, and a well-groomed mustache and goatee. His curly hair extends to the sides and back, with a bald spot at the top, and he is wearing a skullcap. He is dressed in a dark garment with a high white collar and a scarf-like accessory tied at the neck, adorned with a tassel hanging down in the center. The background consists of a line-patterned oval frame that is part of an etched engraving.

artworks.title: Wolfgang-Wilhelm, Count of Pfalz-Neuburg and Duke of Julich-Berg
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of an older man positioned facing slightly to the viewer's right but looking directly at the viewer. He has a prominent nose, a curled mustache, and a short goatee. His hair is waved and reaches just above the shoulders, and he is wearing a small cap on his head. The man is dressed in a dark garment with a high, white, ruffled collar, and a large, ornate pendant hanging from a chain around his neck. The background consists of an oval frame with engraved patterns and Latin text encircling the portrait, along with additional text beneath it. The image appears to be a finely detailed engraving, typical of formal historical portraiture.

artworks.title: Wolfgang William, Count Palatine
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a bust-length portrait. He is facing forward, with his head slightly turned to the left. The man has a high forehead, prominent eyebrows, a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, and short wavy hair. He is wearing a formal outfit with a large ruff collar and a patterned garment. The background includes a circular frame with text and additional Latin text below it. The artwork seems to be an engraved portrait with fine lines and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Wolfgang William, Count Palatine
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the chest up. He is posed formally, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a goatee, mustache, and styled hair. He is wearing a ruffled collar, a cloak with buttons, and is surrounded by a circular frame with text. There are heraldic shields in the upper corners of the frame. Beneath the circular image, there is more text and a shield with a lion. The background within the circle is dark.

artworks.title: Wolfgang William, Count Palatine
artworks.description: There is a portrait of a man with a high forehead, distinct mustache, and pointed beard. He is wearing a ruffled collar and richly detailed clothing. The background includes an oval frame with decorative elements and inscriptions. Below the portrait is decorative script.

artworks.title: Eustace Wolowicz, Archbishop of Vilna
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait, facing forward with a solemn expression. He is depicted with facial hair, wearing a cap and a clerical robe. Around him are cherubs holding religious items, as well as figures of saints labeled as S. Stanislaus and S. Casimirus. The background features ornate scrollwork and Latin inscriptions.
